exact_prompt:
Use case: HD game diffuse UV texture edit, flat painted decal.
Reference: attached image is the ENTIRE original native128x128 storedRGB canvas, exposed as opaqueRGB and enlarged NEAREST4x to512x512. Original native alpha is retained separately and restored by the game pipeline; do not redesign alpha.
Edit this FULL square canvas in place into a higher-resolution plain painted version. Every original connected and disconnected component, contour, dark hole, tail, faint pixel, background gap, angle and relative shade stays at precisely the same normalized UV position/scale. No crop, zoom, padding, rotate, recenter, fitting, atlas or extra border. Canvas edges remain identical sourceUV.
Keep the dim muted dark red/brown color and simple flat matte painted material. This is an abstract diffuse splatter texture, not a scene or wet physical liquid. Do not reinterpret it as glossy droplets, raised pools, viscous folds, reflective liquid, round 3D beads, rocks, veins, glowing rays or organic flesh.
Keep the original main connected irregular patch with broad middle-left red-brown area and lower-right red-brown part separated by the existing dark internal opening; preserve the two existing thin diagonal tails near upper-left/upper-right. Retain every tiny original isolated mark around them in the same position and size; the source guide is the sole map of their count. No new radial branch or drop.
Refine only enlarged coarse pixel steps into softly painted fine detail at the original material scale. Preserve source irregular subtle tonal mottling and soft diffuse boundaries, not extra gritty noise, gritty rim, scratches or decorative turbulent swirls. No new splashes, dots, specks, bright flecks, branches, rounded droplet highlights, lines or sharper contrast; no brightening weak source marks or removing faint parts. Black empty areas and all dark holes stay black. No new forms of any size. Output only this ENTIRE unchanged UV texture, opaqueRGB, with no text, labels, border or comparison.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST integer resize to512px. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
